name: Aegis Session Sweeper
description: Selectively purges expired site browsing data while preserving user allow-lists.
notes: Permission justification: browsingData is required to clear stale cookies, localStorage, and cache for origins older than the retention threshold; storage is required to persist user allow-lists and retention preferences (Privacy Class P1); alarms is used for periodic background sweep scheduling. Operates completely offline with zero external network connectivity.
